Title: Verify order is cancelled and a note is sent to the warehouse if reason = 'Other'
Preconditions:
1.  User signed in as admin
2.  At least one active order exists
3.  Order has at least 1 item linked to a
    warehouse shipment
Steps:
1.  Navigate to Orders - Active
2.  Open the order
3.  Click Cancel
4.  Select reason - ‘Other’
5.  Enter details in the text field and
    submit the form
Expected Result:
1.  Order has Cancelled status and reason: Other, with
    filled in details
2.  Warehouse received a note with correct reason

Title: Verify discount and coupon are cleared after order is cancelled and restored
Description: Coupons must not survive a restore.
Preconditions:
1.  User is signed in as admin.
2.  Order has a coupon applied.
Steps:
1.  Open the order.
2.  Cancel the order.
3.  Restore the order.
4.  Check the totals.
Expected Result:
1.  Coupon field is empty.
2.  Discount is not applied.
